req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-027 requires that POST /players/ returns HTTP 201 and sets a Location header pointing to /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} (as implemented in the source). Tests must: (1) verify the happy path returns 201 with a correct Location header (EP positive), (2) verify the Location header value is exactly correct — not just present (mutation: string mutation), (3) verify a duplicate squad number returns 409 with no Location header (NEG), (4) verify a missing required field returns 422 with no Location header (NEG/DT), and (5) verify the Location header format at a boundary squad number (BVA). The source sets Location to /players/squadnumber/{player.squad_number}, NOT /players/{new_id}, so tests must match the actual implementation. Squad numbers 27+ are safe new values not in the pre-loaded 26-row dataset.

tests.name: test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid new player payload using squad_number=27
trace: R-PLAYER-027: system shall set Location header on 201 Created response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in r.headers
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/27"

test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_player_location_header_exact_squad_number_in_path():

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_not_uuid_based
actions: Assert Location header uses squad number path, not UUID path
expected: Location header does NOT match /players/{uuid} pattern
trace: Catches mutation that changes the Location path template
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import re

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_not_uuid_based():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Loc",
        "lastName": "Header",
        "squadNumber": 29,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers.get("location", "")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/29"
    uuid_pattern = re.compile(r"/players/[0-9a-f-]{36}$")
    assert not uuid_pattern.match(location)

test_post_player_location_header_not_uuid_based()

actions: Assert response body squad_number matches Location header squad_number
expected: Response body id is a valid UUID

STC: state transition from non-existent to created player
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_response_body_and_location_consistent():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Consistent",
        "lastName": "State",
        "squadNumber": 30,
        "position": "Central Midfield"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 30
    assert r.headers.get("location") == "/players/squadnumber/30"
    uuid.UUID(str(body["id"]))
    assert body["firstName"] == "Consistent"
    assert body["lastName"] == "State"

test_post_player_response_body_and_location_consistent()
